fanart_workspace.inbox_intro: Select one or more images, then match them to a game and character on the right.
fanart_workspace.inbox_empty: The inbox is empty, or every image is already staged. Add files to the inbox folder to begin.
fanart_workspace.assignment_panel_intro: Search your master data, confirm the reference image, save batches to the queue, then process everything at once.
fanart_workspace.queued_items_intro: Review everything currently saved in the queue before processing.
fanart_workspace.queue_remove_failed: Could not remove the selected items from the staging queue.
fanart_workspace.reference_appears_here: Reference image will appear here when available.
fanart_workspace.folder_name_character_not_required: This game uses its folder name, so character selection is not required.
fanart_workspace.add_characters_in_admin: Add characters to the main game in admin first.
fanart_workspace.pick_from_list: Pick from the list below with image preview.
fanart_workspace.folder_name_no_reference_needed: This game is set to use its folder name for filenames, so no character reference image is needed.
fanart_workspace.no_reference_yet: This character does not have a reference image yet.
fanart_workspace.select_character_for_preview: Select a character to preview the reference image from your master data.
fanart_workspace.select_game_before_character: Select a game before choosing a character.
fanart_workspace.folder_name_optional: This game uses its folder name, so character selection is optional.
